summary: Unnamed friend/associate on a 516 (Long Island NY) number who acts as a referral partner and middleman rather than a paying client — he introduced his contact Juliana (whose Instagram was hacked/banned) to Derrek for an unban, then spent two weeks brokering price between Derrek and Juliana's Meta connect (a contact saved as 'Jorge'). He pushed Jorge's side down from ~$4–4.5k to $3,250 and finally $2,500 per unban, and floated splitting proceeds with Derrek and cutting Juliana out of any commission. The deal never closed: Juliana recovered her IG on her own via an email reset around 7/17, and Derrek wrote off the connect as 'useless' on 7/18. Worth keeping as a referral source and potential partner on unban volume, not as a customer.
key_facts: Referred Juliana (hacked/banned Instagram) to Derrek on 6/30
Screenshots show he was negotiating with a contact saved as 'jorge new' who offered $4k–$4.5k per unban depending on ban reason
Talked Jorge's side down to $3,250 then $2,500 per unban by 7/7
Derrek's quoted pricing in the thread: $6k, then $4k; said he'd 'break everyone off' on cheaper deals
Derrek separately had a rep doing $2,500 instant unbans in 1–2 hours, pay-after
Claimed Juliana's connect was charging ~$500/unban and pitched ~$50k of unban business at $2,500 a pop
Offered to split whatever he made with Derrek; wanted to be added to the group chat with the Meta rep
Outcome: Juliana got her IG back herself via email recovery ~7/17; Derrek called the connect useless 7/18
Casual/joking tone, mentions a recent surgery — friendly personal rapport alongside business
